name: Kissmanga
draft_reason: kissmanga.in serves Cloudflare's interactive 'Just a moment...' challenge to every plain HTTP request (verified 2026-08-30: HTTP 403 on / and /mangalist). A sandboxed extension has no browser and no way to solve it, so the source would install and then fail every call. The code is complete and correct; set draft to false to publish it if the site stops challenging.
